description: Ding, Yu and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. Hourly wind measurements from 200 turbines and three meteorological masts cover 2010–2011 for spatial and temporal analysis. Coordinates have been shifted and associated with a one-mile grid. The anonymized coordinate system is part of the resource and is not interpreted as geographic longitude/latitude. Coverage is the stated farm measurement collection. Other DSWE spatial datasets differ in turbine counts or periods; shared farm provenance is possible and no independent-farm claim is made. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The native file inventory establishes deposited data, but values and linked file bodies were not read. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance.
